english_research_meaning: The original separates process liveness (/livez) from actual host readiness (/readyz), conditioned on DB, workspace, core import/runtime, scheduler, migrations, identity and versioned environment.
countercase: Passing a process probe is not an accepted authenticated user command or a verified worker/effect result.

english_research_meaning: A host may return HTTP 200 while shared storage, source access or worker capacity is degraded; readiness and component status need distinct truthful projections.
countercase: Do not universally fail all read-only functions due to one optional dependency degradation.

english_research_meaning: Original research proposes converging local desktop and hosted deployments on shared application semantics, potentially via a local managed host.
countercase: Accepted Windows host+client profile does not force every standalone desktop installation to run an embedded host or create two repositories.

english_research_meaning: Original research allows a bounded interim local executor and remote-host executor while migrating Windows state ownership.
countercase: Local historical cases must not be silently imported as host-authoritative work; future transition shape and timeline remain Product decisions.

english_research_meaning: Research enumerates server deployment, HTTPS/auth, rights per object, independent client lifetime, dedupe/cancel and recovery gates for a Web-host MVP.
countercase: OIDC, cookie topology and exact accepted feature list are research suggestions, not automatically imposed Product Decisions.

english_research_meaning: Research separately proposes snapshot/stream reconnect, per-user unread, shared/personal/run file scopes, path/download restrictions, restore, atomic artifacts and disk-full tests.
countercase: These requirements demand actual native Web/Windows/Android and fault tests; a schema and a CI link checker do not prove them.
